port.description: TCP port on which the HTTP server listens for incoming connections.

allow_hosts.description: List of allowed client IP addresses or CIDR ranges. Leave empty to allow all.

deny_hosts.description: List of blocked client IP addresses or CIDR ranges. Empty means no hosts are blocked.

server_root.description: Path to directory containing web UI files (HTML, JS, CSS) to serve. Set to empty string '' to disable static file serving.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections allowed.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which an idle connection is closed.

compression.description: Whether to compress HTTP responses with gzip when supported by the client.

verbosity.description: Logging verbosity level (0–7). Higher values produce more detailed logs.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs go to stderr (or system journal if supervised).

buses.description: List of 1-Wire bus configurations. Each defines a physical or virtual bus.

mount_point.description: Mount point for the 1-Wire filesystem (used only if running owfs separately; optional for shared configs).

ssl_certificate.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file. If provided, HTTPS is enabled. Leave empty to use HTTP only.

ssl_private_key.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (must correspond to the certificate). Required if ssl_certificate is set.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file used for process management (e.g., by systemd or init scripts).
